# TurboKre (Kre³) — Turbo Energy Canine

> Personal homepage of TurboKre, a marketing professional and self-taught furry artist. His artwork, portfolio, friends and contact details live inside "doggobench", a draggable terminal-styled desktop.

TurboKre — also Kreee, or Kre³ for short — works in marketing at a leading personal-care company and began teaching himself digital painting in late 2025. He is less interested in becoming a polished illustrator than in becoming a world-builder: he wants his pictures to carry the stories and characters he keeps in his head.

His persona is a red-furred canine — a red wolf or a red fox, he leaves the verdict to you — usually drawn with a halo and a lightning-bolt emblem. The brand is Turbo Energy Canine (混合动力犬); the host prompt reads `kyree@kre3.net`, and the joke spec sheet lists a "DoggoBrain KindaStupid" CPU and "DoggoEyes NearSighted" GPU. The design is warm graphite, cream paper and signal orange.

- **Handles:** TurboKre, Kreee, Kre³
- **Work:** Marketing at a leading personal-care company; amateur artist
- **Art:** Anthropomorphic ("furry") canine characters, narrative illustration, an osu! long-note tribute; self-taught since late 2025
- **Tech:** Svelte 5 and SvelteKit, static sites, self-hosted networking
- **Languages:** English on the landing page; the blog is bilingual (简体中文 default, English mirror); email in either language is welcome
- **Contact:** contact@kre3.net

**Art.** Six digital paintings so far, mostly of his own canine character: "Team TurboCanine" (the red wolf/fox), "Roger that" (headset portrait), "10★ LN" (an osu! long-note tribute), "Boxing" (his first test piece), "B-day #1" and "Cold Hiking". Character-first rather than landscapes or technique studies; the stated ambition is narrative illustration and original worlds.

**Writing.** The blog is where the other half of his brain shows up: long-form, practical posts on frontend fundamentals (Svelte 5 and Vue 3 from scratch) and self-hosted networking (OPNsense, WireGuard, Unbound, Loki and Grafana). Chinese is the default language with a full English mirror; he writes to learn in public and is candid about what he does not yet understand.

**Site.** Built with Svelte 5 and SvelteKit, prerendered to static HTML, deployed to Cloudflare Pages from GitHub Actions. Signature interactions: a draggable terminal window with a genie-style minimise, a cursor-following torch that reveals its border, background parallax from mouse or device tilt, and artwork-driven accent colours; "Now showing" rotates every 15 seconds. Reduced motion, keyboard focus and JavaScript-off navigation are supported. No analytics or ad scripts; comments are giscus (GitHub Discussions). Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono on graphite `#0b0a09` and cream `#f3ede3`, with signal orange `#ff6a3d`.

**Rights.** Source code is MIT licensed. Artwork, avatars, logos and branding are all rights reserved: they may not be reused or redistributed without permission — including the character designs and the site's visual identity.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kre3.net/): Terminal-style `info` readout with career, species, contact, joke hardware specs, seven social links and a rotating "Now showing" artwork rail.
- [About](https://kre3.net/about): First-person introduction, contact details, generated table of contents and a giscus comment thread.
- [Folio](https://kre3.net/folio): "Work Archive"; currently one early collection, "Test Collection #1" ("learn by drawing"), with six works. Collections are prerendered at `/folio/1`, `/folio/2`, … and works open in a lightbox.
- [Pals](https://kre3.net/pals): Blogroll of five friends' sites with one-line Chinese introductions.

## Writing

- [Blog (简体中文)](https://blog.kre3.net/): Practical posts on frontend and self-hosted networking.
- [Blog (English)](https://blog.kre3.net/en/): English mirror of the same posts.
